description: This file defines stub classes for weather and notification services, including methods to fetch weather forecasts and to send reminder intents, intended as client interfaces for external services.

classes.name: WeatherClient
classes.description: Stub class for weather service integration, providing a method to get weather forecast at a specific datetime for a location.

classes.name: NotificationClient
classes.description: Stub class for notification service integration, providing a method to send reminder intents for events.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_forecast_at(self, location: str, dt: datetime)
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast for a given location and datetime, returns a dummy forecast.

methods.name: send_reminder_intent(self, event_id: str, schedule_times: List[datetime])
methods.description: Sends a reminder intent for an event with specified schedule times, currently a placeholder that logs the action.
